display.use: Vietnamese hooks, short titles, captions and narration text.

latin_auxiliary.use: Chapter numerals, short Latin labels and time figures only.

body.use: Vietnamese narration captions, evidence labels and source credit.

rules: Use condensed display face only for the English wordmark and short Latin labels.
Keep Vietnamese diacritics intact; never synthesize bold for body copy.
On-screen copy is sparse and explanatory; do not transcribe the narration.

layout.host_share: Narrative is carried by voice. Visual evidence owns the frame when it clarifies the point.
layout.caption_anchor: No persistent subtitles; use the frame for authored diagrams or approved media.
layout.evidence_card: One sourced claim when needed; match diagrams and media remain the visual focus.
layout.visual_signature: Match dossier: midnight-ink canvas, warm paper type, brass chapter marks, coral opponent marks, full-height evidence pitch, and directional annotations. No rounded dashboard card.

motion.default_easing: Smooth ease-in-out with a decisive stop.
motion.micro_motion: Use one eased ball movement per authored pass; stop at the receiver. Change visual mode with the story: field evidence, tactical plate, and a quiet chapter card. No looping motion.

audio.narration: Primary and intelligible; music and effects duck under speech.
audio.signature_cue: Original two-note, dry percussive/electronic mark; no stock broadcast whistle or copied club anthem.
audio.music: Optional low-energy bed; never required and never louder than speech.

research_basis.Tifo_Football: Use illustration and animation to make one complex idea legible; do not copy its hand-drawn character style.
research_basis.Independent_ACFC: Pair a clear analysis claim with a match or player focal point and tactical context.
research_basis.Premier_League_Breakdown: Color-code the subject, movement path, and target zone so overlays explain the evidence.
research_basis.adaptation: An original Vietnamese-first editorial dossier: warm restrained accents, chapter numbering, asymmetrical evidence layout, real approved media slots, and simple authored tactical plates.
